title: Light, shadows and effects
author: claude
summary: A warm key light, two soft contact shadows, and optional screen effects.
what: We added a warm-white key light, two soft contact shadows, and optional screen effects.
why: The table needs a little live light and grounding shadows on top of the baked room.
how:
- The key light is warm white (strength 0.8).
- There are two soft contact shadows.
- The effects are optional: soft corner shading (N8AO), tone mapping (Neutral) and smoother edges (SMAA).

tech.name: postprocessing
tech.plain: Adds screen effects such as tone mapping and smoother edges.

tech.name: N8AO
tech.plain: Adds soft shading in corners and creases (ambient occlusion).

tech.name: three.js
tech.plain: Draws 3D scenes in the web browser.

tech.name: Gamma and tone mapping
tech.plain: A way of squeezing very bright light into the range a screen can show.

meta.effects: optional N8AO, Neutral tone mapping, SMAA
